text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporter Otonashi and the other media outlets have announced a new tournament known as the Twinkle Star Climax!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to Director Akikawa, only those who achieve great results in the Twinkle Series may enter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A major competition for the honor of being named the greatest… It sounds like a challenge worth taking on!
